title: Diabetes Self-Management Assessment (DSMA-8)
instructions: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have the following applied to you? There are no right or wrong answers.

items.text: I missed or skipped a dose of my diabetes medication.
I did not check my blood glucose when I was supposed to.
I ate meals or snacks that I know are bad for my glucose control.
I felt unusually thirsty or needed to urinate more often than normal.
I felt shaky, sweaty, or dizzy in a way that felt like low blood sugar.
I went the whole day without any physical activity or walking.
I did not check my feet for cuts, blisters, or sores.
I felt too overwhelmed or discouraged to manage my diabetes.

notes: Fictional instrument created for this challenge.
